meta.title: Community Guidelines | Saturn Chat
meta.description: Learn about the Saturn Chat community rules. Following them is essential for a safe experience for everyone.

Guidelines.title: Saturn Chat Community Guidelines
intro: Saturn Chat was created to connect people through a simple, accessible, and safe platform for everyone.
These guidelines define the behaviors and content that are not allowed on Saturn Chat. Violations may result in measures ranging from content removal to permanent account suspension.
We rely on every user to help maintain a healthy environment. If you identify a violation, please use our reporting channels.
Guidelines.interactionTitle: How to Interact with Other Users
Guidelines.serviceTitle: Content and Use of the Service

rules.title: Do not promote or encourage harassment
rules.body: Disagreements are part of social interaction, but verbal abuse, targeted insults, threats, or intimidation are not tolerated.

rules.title: Do not spread hate speech
rules.body: We do not allow attacks or discrimination based on race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or physical or mental disabilities.

rules.title: Do not make threats or blackmail others
rules.body: Threatening users or exposing their personal information, such as email, phone number, address, or photos, without permission is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Do not impersonate another person
rules.body: Creating fake profiles to impersonate individuals, brands, public figures, or Saturn Chat team members is prohibited.

rules.title: Do not run scams or financial fraud
rules.body: You may not use the platform to promote pyramid schemes, investment fraud, or request other users' banking details and passwords.

rules.title: Do not send malicious code or suspicious links
rules.body: Hacking attempts, virus or malware distribution, phishing, and denial-of-service attacks (DDoS) are prohibited.

rules.title: Zero tolerance for child exploitation
rules.body: Sharing or requesting sexual content involving minors is strictly prohibited, including links, digitally altered media, or suggestive material.

rules.title: Do not promote self-harm or suicide
rules.body: Encouraging, glorifying, or providing instructions for self-harm, suicide, or eating disorders is not allowed. Seek professional support if you are going through a difficult time.

rules.title: Do not trade illegal or regulated products
rules.body: Using Saturn Chat to trade firearms, illegal drugs, controlled medication, ammunition, or other restricted products is prohibited.

rules.title: Do not distribute pirated or hacking material
rules.body: Do not share leaked data, cracked software, hacking tools, stolen accounts, or game cheats.

rules.title: Respect copyright and intellectual property
rules.body: Do not share content that violates patents, trademarks, or third-party copyrights without proper legal authorization.

rules.title: Respect other people's privacy
rules.body: Sharing intimate images or videos without the consent of those involved, including revenge porn or intimidation, is a serious violation.

rules.title: Do not send spam or use unauthorized automation
rules.body: Repeated messages, unsolicited affiliate links, mass account creation, or unauthorized scraping bots harm the community and are prohibited.

rules.title: Do not exploit vulnerabilities or overload systems
rules.body: If you find a bug or vulnerability in Saturn Chat, report it to our team instead of exploiting or sharing it to harm service stability.

Guidelines.outro: Following these guidelines helps keep Saturn Chat a healthy and safe place for everyone.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | Saturn Chat
meta.description: We take your privacy seriously. Learn how we use your data on Saturn Chat.

interpretation.title: Interpretation and Definitions
interpretation.subtitle: Interpretation
interpretation.body: Capitalized words have specific meanings defined below. The definitions have the same meaning in the singular and plural.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.intro: For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

0.body: a unique account created for you to access our Service or parts of it.

1.body: an entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party; control means owning 50% or more of shares, equity, or voting rights.

2.body: Saturn Chat, the software program provided by the Company.

3.body: Saturn Chat, also referred to as the Company, We, Us, or Our in this Agreement.

5.body: any device that can access the Service, such as a computer, phone, or tablet.

6.body: any information related to an identified or identifiable individual.

8.body: any person or entity that processes data on behalf of the Company, including third parties that help provide or analyze the Service.

9.body: information collected automatically through use of the Service or its infrastructure, such as access logs and diagnostics.

10.body: the individual accessing or using the Service, or the entity on whose behalf they do so.

collection.title: Collection and Use of Your Personal Data

personal.title: Personal Data
personal.intro: When using our Service, we may ask you to provide personally identifiable information to contact or identify you. This may include:

media.title: Messages, Audio, and Media Files
media.intro: Because Saturn Chat is a communication app, we process transmitted content to enable real-time messaging:

items.body: message, audio, and file content is transferred using secure protocols with encryption in transit (TLS/HTTPS).
messages and media are stored on our servers or cloud infrastructure providers' servers to ensure delivery and synchronization across devices.

usageData.title: Usage Data
usageData.0: Usage Data is collected automatically when you use the Service.
usageData.1: It may include your IP address, operating system, device identifiers, error logs, connection times, and other technical diagnostics.

permissions.title: Device Permissions and Access
permissions.intro: Some features may require authorization for the following access:

items.body: to send photos and videos and select a profile picture.
to record and send audio messages in conversations.
to alert you about new messages and status updates.

permissions.outro: You can grant or revoke these permissions at any time in your device privacy settings.

use.title: Use of Your Personal Data
use.intro: The Company may use Personal Data for the following purposes:

items.body: including message delivery, notifications, and real-time content transmission.
managing your registration and authentication as a Service user.
monitoring failures, preventing fraud, and protecting system stability.
sending important notices about your account or Service updates.
handling requests sent to our support team.
conducting aggregate analysis and improving the technical performance of the Application.

retention.title: Data Retention and Deletion
retention.0: We retain Personal Data only as long as necessary to fulfill this Policy or legal obligations.
retention.1: You may request permanent deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting our support team.

security.title: Security of Your Personal Data
security.body: Protecting your Personal Data and communications is a priority. We use security standards and encryption, but no Internet transmission or electronic storage method is completely secure.

rights.title: Your Privacy Rights
rights.intro: You may have specific rights regarding your personal information under applicable law:
items: Confirm whether your data is processed and request access to it;
Request correction of incomplete or outdated data;
Request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data;
Withdraw your consent to data processing;
Request permanent deletion of your account and data.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: Our Service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect their personal information without consent from a parent or legal guardian.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will publish the new version on this page and update the Last updated date.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions or want to exercise your privacy rights, contact us:

Home.title: Connect with the world
Home.subtitle: With Saturn Chat, you can connect with your school group, friends, or family while enjoying features that make conversations faster and more dynamic without compromising your privacy. Ready to start your journey?

0.title: Create your community and start connecting!
0.subtitle: Saturn Chat groups are ready to welcome as many people as you need. With just a few taps, you can create your group and invite your entire community with customizable invitations that you fully control.

1.title: Be discoverable or keep your private space
1.subtitle: You can create public groups that appear in Saturn Chat searches and allow anyone to join. You can also create private groups that do not appear in searches and can only be joined by people who receive an invitation.

2.title: Simple for everyone
2.subtitle: With Saturn Chat, you will not feel overwhelmed by endless buttons. Our interface is simple yet powerful, so you can fully configure a group in just a few taps and welcome your users comfortably and securely.

3.title: Fast, easy, and secure
3.subtitle: Saturn Chat gives you a fast app that works well on most devices, with low latency, secure message delivery, and low resource usage.

Download.title: Choose your device and start having fun
Download.subtitle: An exciting journey is waiting for you. Just download Saturn Chat on your device.
Download.unsupported: The app is not currently supported on this device. See the supported platforms below.
